headline: Strong asset pipeline to drive growth

highlights: With CHALET’s operational hotels’ portfolio poised to grow by 1,655 keys to over 5,400 keys by Mar’30E, alongside its leasing traction, we estimate 15%/20% revenue/EBITDA CAGRs over FY26–29 (ex-residential).
Retain BUY with an unchanged SoTP- based TP of INR 1,095, basis 22x Mar’28E hotel EV/EBITDA.
Steady quarter, improving demand outlook CHALET clocked Q2FY27 hotel revenue of INR 4.2bn (up 8% YoY) as portfolio RevPAR grew 7% YoY.
Hence, Q2FY27 hotel EBITDA of INR 1.7bn grew 11% YoY with a 110bps expansion in EBITDA margin to 41%.
valuation: Retain BUY with an unchanged SoTP- based TP of INR 1,095, basis 22x Mar’28E hotel EV/EBITDA.
The views and opinions expressed in this document may or may not match or may be contrary with the views, estimates, rating, and target price of the Retail Research.
